book.name: 2 TIMOTI
book.title: Timoti wana Leta Labuina Pol wana Leleli

content: Nau Pol, Yehoba wana nuwatu eliyana ya tabwa Keliso Yeisu wana apostolo, inoke yawal toto Yehoba i batelela Keliso Yeisu eliyana na wasaan.

Leta ya ya leli ge ya patuna Timoti eliyam, owa u ola natu nunuwanina. Ya awanun Yehoba Tamala ge Keliso Yeisu wala Babala nihi mulolu ge nihi atilomwan-agiwa, ge wali nuwa laumwal atem ni pakalaopop.
Pol Timoti I Ba Pagasisi Ni Tuwalali Bubun
Ya ba mulolu Yehoba elana, iya tubuwau wali Yabowaine, ge nau al ge ya kululu tunahot eliyana. Sauga gegewena bulin ge lan ya awaawanun Yehoba elana kaiwem, yaka ya ba mulolu kaiwem.
Ya nuwahikan sauga valila ya tataluwagiwa ge u kahin, inoke nuwau hot na kitewa al ge yaliyaya ateu ni kalaopopwi.
Wam abulilek hot ya nuwahikan. He tubum meluyovana Lois iya toabulilek hot ge hinam Yunisi al ge, ge ya atena bubun abulilek o i gan al eliyam.

Heiya te kaiwena ge sauga ya ya panuwahikagiwa am gabom toto Yehoba i pewa nu patuwalali pagasisi. Gabom o valila Yehoba i pewa sauga toto nimwau ya teli kokowamwa ge ya awanun kaiwem. Am gabom nu patuwalali pagasisi,
kaiwena Yayaluwa Bwabwalena toto Yehoba i pem elala, nige yayaluwa pulupuluwawena i oola, yaa i labela ta gasisi, ta nunuwana, ge i labela al wala pagan ta matahikan.

Inoke Babala wasana nu wasawasa-an ya, bahi nu pupuluwawi. I ola al, no ulutuk dela Yeisu kaiwena, bahi kaiwena ge nu pupuluwawi-agau. Yaa nu talamwagiwa lomwan nu pwawa Wasa Waiwaisana kaiwena, ni ola nau lomwan ya pwawa, ge Yehoba iya ni pagasisewa.

Yehoba i pwamwalila ge i yogaagila ta tabwa wana gamagalau. He nige wala ginol waiwaisal kaiweliya i oola ge i pwamwalila, yaa kaiwena wana nuwatu i ola, ge wana mulolu bwagabwaga kaiwena. Yehoba nige ga panayawi i giginol inoke i nuwatu Keliso Yeisu eliyana wana mulolu ni pem elala,

yaa abwe sauga ya wala Topwamwal Keliso Yeisu i nem, inoke mulolu bwagabwaga o i masal mwananala ge ta kite. Ibwe, Yeisu i nem inoke yaomal wana gasisi i pwamowasi, ge i pankitela yawal mihomihotina ta pwawa ebo Wasa Waiwaisana ta hago ge ta abulilek-an.
Yehoba i hileyau ya tabwa apostolo ge Wasa Waiwaisana o na wasawasa-an ge na panpankiti-an,

inoke heiya te kaiwena ge sauga ya lomwan ya pwawa. Yaa nige ateu i bwanabwana, kaiwena Babala toto ana mel ya teli ya atena bubun, ge iya bosowaina tuwalali toto i pem elau ni matahikan ana siga lan mowamowasena.
Panpankiti sasapona toto ya pankitewa nu pihikan momol yaka nu panpankiti-an gamagalau elal, ge nu minaa abulilek ge nunuwana paganina elal ni ola toto Yeisu Keliso wana kamwasa.
Wasa Waiwaisana toto Yehoba i pewa nu wasaan, iya bugul waiwaisana hot, inoke Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i minaa eliyala wana gasisi elana nu matahikan bubun.
Iyaka u atena Pigelas ge Hemogenis, avaliyau toabulilek hi gewi labi Eisiya gamwanaa, hi lou luwagau ge o en hi pem.
Yaa Onesipolas sauga i gewi i payaliyaya-agau, inoke ya awanun iya alonau ge wana boda Babala ni muloluagil. Bwagana ya minaa dela, nige i pupuluwawi-agau,
yaa sauga i vin Loma, yaka i loya nabinabi kaiweu ana siga i pwawau.
Ge u atena bubun valila nau iyahe tei Epeso elana inoke i labeyau bubun. He ya awanun lan mowamowasena elana Babala ni atilomwan-an.
